appDescription.message: Detects phishing-like URL patterns and explains the warning signs in plain language, without blocking anything.
appDescription.description: Extension description shown in the store and extension manager

m0Status.description: Placeholder status shown until the M1 engine ships

m0Note.message: FishCatcher is installed. URL analysis arrives with the next update. Nothing is sent anywhere, everything stays on your device.
m0Note.description: Placeholder explanation shown in popup and panel

panelHint.message: When you visit a page, FishCatcher will show its verdict here and explain every warning sign it finds.
panelHint.description: Panel placeholder explaining the future behavior

reasonBrand.message: Domain looks like a misspelling of $1
reasonBrand.description: S1 typo-squat signal; $1 = real brand domain

reasonHomoglyph.description: S2 IDN/homoglyph signal; $1 = imitated brand name

reasonBrandSubdomain.message: Mentions $1 but is not a $1 domain

reasonIp.message: Address is a raw IP number. Legitimate sites rarely do this

reasonAtSign.message: Everything before @ in the address is ignored by the browser

reasonKeyword.message: Contains a word often used in phishing pages ($1)

reasonSubdomains.message: Unusually deep chain of subdomains ($1 parts)
reasonSubdomains.description: S8 deep subdomain signal; $1 = label count

reasonHttp.message: Connection is not encrypted (http instead of https)

reasonDigits.message: Domain has an unusual mix of digits and hyphens

levelElevated.message: Some unusual signs. Double-check the address

levelHigh.message: Multiple phishing indicators. Be careful before logging in

levelCritical.message: Strong phishing signs. Don't enter passwords here

trustButton.description: Popup button: whitelist the current registrable domain locally

untrustButton.description: Popup button: remove local whitelist entry

recheckButton.description: Popup button: re-score the current tab

reasonsTitle.description: Popup heading above the reasons list

noCheck.message: This page can't be checked (browser pages are out of scope)
noCheck.description: Popup status for chrome:// and other uncheckable pages

strictLabel.message: Strict mode: show a warning banner on risky pages

strictHint.message: Off by default. The banner never blocks the page and can always be dismissed.

remoteUrlLabel.description: Options: remote update URL field label

remoteHint.message: Optional. Only a JSON file is downloaded. Nothing leaves your device.

reasonBlocklist.message: This domain is on the local blocklist of known-bad sites

reasonPasswordForm.message: The page asks for a password on a site that isn't a known legitimate domain

deviceCodeNotice.description: Educational notice on legitimate device-code entry pages

qrNone.message: No QR code found in that image.

qrResultNote.message: Result for the scanned QR code:
qrResultNote.description: Panel note above a QR check result

ctxCheckQr.description: Right-click context menu item on images

reasonYoungDomain.description: S15 opt-in RDAP age check signal; $1 = age in days

reasonBloom.message: Matches the community threat feed (probabilistic match)

cloudLabel.message: Cloud age check: ask public RDAP how old the domain is

cloudHint.message: Sends only the registrable domain to rdap.org. Off by default.

remoteDefaultHint.description: Options: lead-in before the registry link

remoteSourceLink.description: Options: link text pointing to the registry repository

remoteReadyNoCount.message: Threat list is up to date.
remoteReadyNoCount.description: Update status when the count is not known

reasonMl.message: The domain's letter pattern resembles automatically generated random domains

linksNone.message: No risky links found on this page.
linksNone.description: Panel note when a link scan finds nothing

linkTextMismatch.message: Link shows $1 but actually goes to $2
linkTextMismatch.description: Link finding: visible text domain differs from destination; $1 shown, $2 real

linkDownloadMismatch.message: Saved as .$2 but it is really a .$1 file
linkDownloadMismatch.description: Link finding: download attribute hides the real file type; $1 real ext, $2 claimed ext

linkShortener.message: Shortened link ($1). The real destination is hidden
linkShortener.description: Link finding: known URL shortener; $1 = shortener domain

linkRisky.description: Link finding: destination scored high/critical by the engine; $1 = domain

downloadGuardLabel.message: Download guard: warn about disguised or dangerous downloads

downloadGuardHint.message: Checks each download's real type against its name. Needs download and notification access, requested when you turn it on. Off by default.

downloadMismatchBody.message: "$1" is actually a $2, not what its name suggests. Do not open it unless you trust the source.
downloadMismatchBody.description: Download guard: filename disguises the real type; $1 name, $2 real type

downloadDangerousBody.message: "$1" is a program ($2), not a document. Only open it if you trust the source.

linksChecked.description: Shown after a link scan; $1 = number of links checked

linksUnavailable.message: Could not read this page's links. Reload the page and try again.

checkingLabel.description: Button label while re-checking the page and its links

trustConfirm.description: Confirmation after trusting a site; $1 = domain

downloadActive.description: Settings status when the download guard is on

cloudActive.message: Checking domain age on risky sites.
cloudActive.description: Settings status when the cloud age check is on

ageChecking.description: Panel note while an RDAP age lookup is in progress
